title: CONSIDER: A. APPROVING the programming of an additional $5,183,184 within the capacity of Measure M Multi-Year Subregional Program (MSP) - Active…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0532, Program]
[PLANNING AND PROGRAMMING COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (4-0):]
CONSIDER:

A.	APPROVING the programming of an additional $5,183,184 within the capacity of Measure M Multi-Year Subregional Program (MSP) - Active Transportation Program, and reprogramming project funds previously approved to meet the project schedule, as shown in Attachment A; and

B.	AUTHORIZING the Chief Executive Officer or their designee to negotiate and execute all necessary agreements and/or amendments for approved projects.
summary: Approves programming of $5.18 million within Measure M Multi-Year Subregional Program for Active Transportation projects and authorizes CEO to negotiate agreements.
